title: Collatz: certificate transport, cycle bounds and escape rigidity
body:
## Status and full-proof target

**Collatz is not proved by this PR.** The latest pass re-evaluated the current closing work and used three GPT-6.2 Astra agents at ultra effort to attack actual-certificate transport, full-denominator cycle restrictions, and an unchanged escaping ordinary trajectory. It produced six new Lean modules and scoped written results; the universal bridge is still open.

Published head: `07d494324c7ea440d45845d725f5cebad8a67124`  
Scientific checkpoint: `966ddadb86240ac3c2cecf551bb682738d11f03b`

[Final Lean proposal and exact missing steps](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/07d494324c7ea440d45845d725f5cebad8a67124/research/astra-full-proof-20261125/FINAL_PROPOSAL.md) · [Research packet](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/07d494324c7ea440d45845d725f5cebad8a67124/research/astra-full-proof-20261125/README.md) · [Independent reviews and root assessment](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/07d494324c7ea440d45845d725f5cebad8a67124/reports/astra-full-proof-20261125/ROOT_REVIEW.md) · [Frozen latest-source intake](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/07d494324c7ea440d45845d725f5cebad8a67124/reports/astra-full-proof-20261125/LATEST_INTAKE.md)

## What this continuation adds

### Actual certificates and ordinary replacements

The signed-prefix kernel works at arbitrary upper rank. It proves literal ordinary meetings across different signed reference charts and constructs the replacement triple's hitting witness with its exact odd count. Contracting periodic reference centers give explicit height descent, uniformly over positive cofactors, subject to the stated seed and phase hypotheses.

On a specified canonical slice, every supplied upper hit passes to its same suffix with two fewer odd inputs. The resulting good-base/bad-multiple orientation is explicit. A separate height criterion handles sufficiently long initial halving blocks.

An unrestricted rank-two reduction checks 16,733 short-clock sources and 173 symbolic competitor pairs, leaving 91 pairs `(e,H mod 486)`. This is distinct from PR197's canonical `17 mod 48` least-defect problem. The kernel also proves an infinite family whose triple first hits with two odds while every lower clock through that hit exceeds its source. These inputs are outside the canonical residue class and are not asserted bad.

[Transport statement, dependencies and residuals](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/07d494324c7ea440d45845d725f5cebad8a67124/research/astra-full-proof-20261125/transport/README.md) · [All-rank kernels](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/07d494324c7ea440d45845d725f5cebad8a67124/research/astra-full-proof-20261125/transport/SignedPrefix.lean)

### Cycles with arbitrarily high excursions

A sufficiently long ordinary positive cycle must have more than `p/300` odd phases above `12s/5`, using Wu–Wang's published logarithm estimate. The rational form concludes that the full reduced denominator exceeds `p^(1/10)` when the occupation condition fails. The count permits arbitrarily high intervening excursions. Lean checks its clipped clock budget and complete-power terminal injection.

The stronger `14s/5` and two-gap `3s` thresholds retain the separately stated Chudnovsky preprint dependency. A rational construction shows that both actual rank orders and the other displayed geometric tests still permit a union of window words with entropy exceeding `ln(3)/3`; those examples have exponentially large denominators. The remaining cycle argument must use ordinary or least-basin arithmetic beyond those geometric tests.

[Cycle proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/07d494324c7ea440d45845d725f5cebad8a67124/research/astra-full-proof-20261125/cycle/README.md) · [Scope of the entropy construction](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/07d494324c7ea440d45845d725f5cebad8a67124/research/astra-full-proof-20261125/cycle/ORDER_ENTROPY.md)

### Fixed-orbit rigidity

The written theorem shows that a positive ordinary trajectory is eventually periodic if and only if its heights admit a finite-dimensional rational dynamical representation over a characteristic-zero field. Fixed-order, uniformly bounded-degree fits to every finite prefix also suffice when denominators stay nonzero on the data. Lean proves the Noetherian-space/clopen-parity core.

A separate written theorem makes eventual periodicity equivalent to a scalar Mahler equation for the full weighted parity series. Its transfer at a possibly singular point uses finite jets and Adamczewski–Bell–Smertnig's published lifting theorem. The finite weighted telescope is checked in Lean. No argument establishes the required rational model or Mahler equation for every ordinary trajectory; nontrivial positive cycles pass both tests.

[Fixed-orbit proofs and hypotheses](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/07d494324c7ea440d45845d725f5cebad8a67124/research/astra-full-proof-20261125/global/README.md) · [Noetherian Lean theorem](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/07d494324c7ea440d45845d725f5cebad8a67124/research/astra-full-proof-20261125/global/RationalModel.lean)

- Six new modules plus two local project dependencies rebuilt in an empty object directory with `-j1 -DwarningAsError=true -DautoImplicit=false`.
- **24 new public declarations + 23 dependency declarations = 47 named transitive axiom audits**. Only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`; no project `sorry`, `admit`, custom axiom, or `native_decide` in these proof sources.
- Four finite controls passed in normal and optimized Python with identical output, including an independently written physical replay of the replacement charts.
- `python -X utf8 -B tools/validate.py --regressions`: **all 11 commands passed** on the scientific checkpoint.
- The follow-up changes only reports. A separate clean complete checkout of the **published head**, with **942 tracked files**, matched all **20** scientific/dependency/control hashes and passed all **11** validator commands again. Exact final tree: `15f3433d13b2b1b63e968827dfe2b97e35df3690`.

[Full execution report](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/07d494324c7ea440d45845d725f5cebad8a67124/reports/astra-full-proof-20261125/VERIFICATION.md) · [Raw replay receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/07d494324c7ea440d45845d725f5cebad8a67124/reports/astra-full-proof-20261125/fresh_replay/receipt.json) · [Scientific checkout validator receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/07d494324c7ea440d45845d725f5cebad8a67124/reports/astra-full-proof-20261125/fresh_replay/repository-validation.json)

These checks certify the displayed kernel statements and bounded computations. They do not formalize the infinite entropy/analytic arguments, rebuild the external logarithm or Mahler theorems, or supply the universal missing hypothesis.

## Remaining proof obligation

For each actual surviving least defect, construct a useful ordinary replacement or sufficiently small actual lower endpoint with its source restrictions and certificate costs preserved. Alternatively, establish a universal boundedness bridge and separately exclude every nontrivial ordinary positive cycle. Neither route is complete.

The earlier PR192 results remain in the branch. [Previous PR description](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/07d494324c7ea440d45845d725f5cebad8a67124/reports/astra-full-proof-20261125/PREVIOUS_PR_DESCRIPTION.json) preserves their summary and links. This remains a draft research PR; no main-branch merge is requested.
